parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "ticker": "{{ $json.ticker }}",
  "signal_date": "{{ $json._indicators.signal_date }}",
  "price_at_signal": {{ $json._indicators.close }},
  "entry_low": {{ $json.entry_low !== null && $json.entry_low !== undefined ? $json.entry_low : 'null' }},
  "entry_high": {{ $json.entry_high !== null && $json.entry_high !== undefined ? $json.entry_high : 'null' }},
  "stop": {{ $json.stop !== null && $json.stop !== undefined ? $json.stop : 'null' }},
  "target": {{ $json.target !== null && $json.target !== undefined ? $json.target : 'null' }},
  "setup_type": "{{ $json.setup_type }}",
  "conviction": "{{ $json.conviction }}",
  "timeframe": "daily",
  "status": "open",
  "indicator_snapshot": {
    "rsi": {{ $json._indicators.rsi_14 }},
    "macd_line": {{ $json._indicators.macd_line }},
    "macd_signal": {{ $json._indicators.macd_signal }},
    "macd_histogram": {{ $json._indicators.macd_histogram }},
    "bb_upper": {{ $json._indicators.bb_upper }},
    "bb_mid": {{ $json._indicators.bb_mid }},
    "bb_lower": {{ $json._indicators.bb_lower }},
    "bb_width": {{ $json._indicators.bb_width }},
    "bb_pct_b": {{ $json._indicators.bb_pct_b }},
    "atr": {{ $json._indicators.atr_14 }},
    "ema_200": {{ $json._indicators.ema_200 }},
    "ema_200_slope": "{{ ($json._indicators.ema_200 - $json._indicators.ema_200_10ago) / $json._indicators.ema_200_10ago >= 0.005 ? 'rising' : ($json._indicators.ema_200 - $json._indicators.ema_200_10ago) / $json._indicators.ema_200_10ago <= -0.005 ? 'declining' : 'flat' }}",
    "volume_vs_avg": {{ $json._indicators.volume_vs_avg }}
  },
  "ai_reasoning": "{{ $json.reasoning }}"
}

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { message: 'Skipped — insufficient data', ticker: $json.ticker } };
return { json: { message: 'No qualifying setup', ticker: $json.ticker } };
